summary: AI-ADMIN-001 end-to-end verification passed. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests via public URL (auth gating 401, status providers with key_present bool, tenants list contains masci, provider test endpoint returns no raw keys, PUT capabilities returns changed_fields+modules, audit endpoint returns entries with actor/note, cleanup PUT ok). Frontend: /admin/ai-configuration renders admin-ai-configuration-page with all 20 required data-testids (5 status cards, admin-ai-routing, admin-ai-tenant-btn-masci, master + 6 module toggles, save/discard/change-note, disabled-mode-proof, audit-log). Save flow: toggling master + daily_report_summary + note + admin-ai-save produced PUT 200 with success toast 'Tenant AI settings saved.' and admin-ai-audit-entry-0 showing TENANT_AI_ENABLED and DAILY_REPORT_SUMMARY_ENABLED plus the note. No raw sk- API keys anywhere on the page HTML. Unauthenticated access to /admin/ai-configuration redirects to /admin/login (Admin Sign In). /daily/submit page contains no 'AI Configuration' chrome (regression clean). Admin sidebar shows 'AI Configuration' nav entry under System & Governance (visible in screenshot). MASCI state reset to tenant_ai_enabled=false, daily_report_summary_enabled=false after test.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: /sign-in path currently redirects unauth admin users to /admin/login (single admin login form) rather than the multi-login form. Frontend admin login form at /admin/login did not populate localStorage.masci.admin.token in our automated attempt — worked around by calling POST /api/auth/multi-login directly and seeding localStorage. Real users using the multi-login on /sign-in should be unaffected, but recommend confirming the admin sign-in UX end-to-end for humans.
seed_data_creation: None; MASCI tenant state reset to off after test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI-ADMIN-001 fully verified. Backend endpoints under /api/admin/ai/* require X-Admin-Token from portal_tokens.admin. Frontend uses localStorage keys masci.admin.token (+ masci.portal_tokens, masci.user) — when driving via Playwright, seed these directly after calling /api/auth/multi-login rather than trying to submit /admin/login form. All 20 data-testids on /admin/ai-configuration render as expected. No secret leakage. Existing pytest suites test_ai_admin_001_config.py (17) and test_ai_config_001_capabilities.py (17) remain intact.
